Most expensive Kimi model — 3x the price of K2.6/K2.7 Code ($0.95/$4.00) and 5x the price of K2.5 ($0.60/$3.00). 1.05M context is the largest context window in Moonshot's lineup. NOTE: Kimi K3 is NOT on Moonshot's Batch pricing supported model list — batch discount (60% off) applies only to K2.7 Code, K2.6, and K2.5. Kimi K3 has no batch discount available as of Sep 2026.
